detail.longDescription: "The White House is scrapping plans for an executive order that would give the Trump administration more control over grantmaking at the National Institutes of Health, a person familiar with the matter said Wednesday." https:// rollcall.com/2026/09/23/white- house-drops-executive-order-for-tighter-nih-purview/ # NIH # biomedical # research # grants # funding # USpol
